messages:
Nora: Heads-up: support tickets increasing when customers send mixed-dim batches that cause runtime to split unexpectedly. Idea: expose a small 'prefetch & hint' preflight call that returns recommended split plan and estimated units so clients can adapt before sending.

Sahil: Good. Need contract: preflight should accept an array of items with dims or null (unknown) and return per-item expected fragment count + estimated units and a confidence score. Also warn if any item will trigger a 413.

Ivy: Console UX: add a 'Preflight history' foldout on the Route page showing last 24h preflight runs, average predicted vs actual fragments, and a mismatch rate. Helps customers debug client vs server split behavior.

Nora: Telemetry: emit preflight.predicted_fragments and request.actual_fragments, tag by tenant+route+model. We'll compute false_positive/negative rates over 1h windows.

Sahil: Implementation: small sync endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight that runs cheap shape logic (no heavy kernel). Use the same splitter heuristics as router but skip queuing. Keep rate limit to 10r/min per token.

Ivy: For the console card show a simple pass/fail with 'recommended_adjustment' e.g., "increase client-batch by 2" or "send as multiple requests" and link to SDK code snippet.

Nora: Also propose an opt-in 'SLA-aware routing' flag per-tenant that tells router to prefer low-p99 paths for preflight-approved batches. Only allowed for tenants with reserved capacity or explicit opt-in.

Sahil: Ops caveat: SLA-aware routing increases cost and can be suppressed if tenant batch_util <25% for 15m (we should avoid wasting fastpath). Emit tenant.sla_pref_suppressed events.

ops-bot: job/preflight-endpoint created (job-ops-20240601-11).

Ivy: Rollout: 1) internal beta + console read-only 2) open to SDK users with opt-in 3) default visible analytics after two weeks. Action items: Sahil spec endpoint + rate limits, Nora wire telemetry, Ivy mock UI + copy.

console-bot: Draft card 'Preflight & Split Insights' added: panels = predicted vs actual fragments, mismatch rate, recent preflight runs.
